hero.place: Cổ Cò Riverside · Đà Nẵng – Hội An
hero.titleB: Noble Horses on the Cổ Cò River
hero.lead: From the first touch of a gentle horse's mane to free-spirited strides into a Wild West sunset. Every journey is crafted to a high standard, blending the class of noble equestrian sport with the calm of the prairie.

coaching.title: Professional 1:1 Coaching
coaching.text: A trainer beside you at every step

stable.title: Timber-Arch Stables and the Cổ Cò River
stable.text: A Western Ranch place to unwind

basics.title: Horse Basics Class
basics.subtitle: An Introductory Riding Class
basics.text: Carefully designed for beginners and anyone who wants to move past first-time nerves. You'll be guided through approaching, brushing the mane, settling into the horse's rhythm and handling the reins calmly in a completely safe sand arena.

duration.title: 45 Minutes
duration.text: 15 minutes of orientation + 30 minutes in the saddle

method.title: 1:1 Coaching
method.text: A trainer beside you at every step

features.f1: International-standard helmet, leather boots and safety vest provided.
features.f2: Learn to read body language, stroke and brush the mane to build trust with your horse.
features.f3: Practice the basic walk on a sand circle, led by your trainer.

wildWest.title: Wild West Cowboy
wildWest.subtitle: and International-Standard Arena
wildWest.text: Become a true Wild West rider. Put on a leather vest worn in by the prairie, a Stetson hat, a red bandana and cowboy boots. Take command of your pace across a wide competition-grade sand arena with the Cổ Cò breeze in your face.

outfit.title: Full Cowboy Set
outfit.text: Stetson hat, leather boots and vest

arena.title: International Sand Arena
arena.text: Soft sand that protects the hooves

features.f1: Practice a steady, upright Western saddle seat.
features.f2: Get used to the trot, S-shaped turns and a clean halt.
features.f3: Includes 01 Bách Mã Signature drink (coconut coffee or a refreshing Western Tea).

photo.title: Cinematic Ranch and Art Photo Tour
photo.text: Capture cinematic photos with our well-trained horses against the timber-arch stables and the scenic Cổ Cò riverscape. Includes 120 unhurried minutes with your crew, a trainer to help with posing and safety, and all original high-quality files delivered.

crew.title: Crew of Up to 5
crew.text: Ideal for friends, families and studios

horses.title: 02 Well-Trained Horses
horses.text: With a trainer for posing and safety

room.title: VIP Prep Room
room.text: Air-conditioned changing room and welcome drinks

workshop.title: Stable Care Workshop
workshop.subtitle: and Daily Life on the Ranch
workshop.text: Spend a day as a young stable guardian. The whole family breathes in the gentle scent of dry straw, discovers how horses sleep standing up and prepares fresh grass and sweet carrots for the herd.

feed.title: Prepare Meals and Hand-Feed
feed.text: Wash fresh carrots, fluff fragrant hay and feed the gentle horses yourself.

groom.title: Bathing, Grooming and Hoof Care
groom.text: Work with a hoof brush and mane comb to learn how a horse's legs are protected.

stable.title: Explore the Timber Stables
stable.text: Learn how naturally ventilated stables stay safe and friendly for the horses.

comparison.title: What Each Package Includes
comparison.description: Pick what suits you, your family or your group best when you visit Bách Mã Viên.

menuTeaser.title: Enjoy Coconut Coffee by the Cổ Cò River
menuTeaser.text: After your time in the saddle, stop by the Ranch Bar for coconut coffee, fruit teas and iced sodas while the sun sets over the river.

tickets.title: Bách Mã Viên Wristband Tickets
tickets.description: Three wristband tickets: Visit the Farm, Cowboy Package and Real Cowboy Package. Contact our concierge for the full benefits of each.

gallery.title: Everyday Moments and Wild Architecture
gallery.description: Every corner of the ranch is designed with the free spirit of the West in mind, ready to capture your most emotional frames.

cta.title: Reserve Your Experience
cta.text: To keep everyone safe and every lesson truly one-to-one, Bách Mã Viên limits guests per time slot. Please book at least 24 hours in advance.
